title: Differentiating a weak identity in a direction e
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l), U an open subset of R^n, ω₁, ω₂ : R^n -> L* = L(L, R) both C^1 on U (as maps into the normed space L*), and e ∈ R^n. Assume ∫_U ω₁(x)[Dφ(x)] dx = ∫_U ω₂(x)[Dφ(x)] dx for every C^1 compactly supported φ : R^n -> R^l with tsupport φ ⊆ U. Then for every C^1 compactly supported ζ : R^n -> R^l with tsupport ζ ⊆ U, the functions F_i(x) := (Dω_i(x) e)[Dζ(x)] (i = 1, 2) are integrable on U and ∫_U F_1 dx = ∫_U F_2 dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (ω₁ ω₂ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ω₁ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ω₂ U → (∀ φ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, ω₁ x (fderiv ℝ φ x) = ∫ x in U, ω₂ x (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → IntegrableOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ ω₁ x e (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) U ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ ω₂ x e (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) U ∧ ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ ω₁ x e (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ ω₂ x e (fderiv ℝ ζ x)
